WITH
-- 1. ARDS male inpatients aged 71-81
ards_cohort AS (
  SELECT
    a.subject_id,
    a.hadm_id,
    a.admittime,
    p.anchor_age,
    a.hospital_expire_flag
  FROM
    `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.admissions` a
    JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.patients` p
      ON a.subject_id = p.subject_id
    JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.diagnoses_icd` d
      USING(subject_id, hadm_id)
    JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.d_icd_diagnoses` dc
      ON d.icd_code = dc.icd_code
       AND d.icd_version = dc.icd_version
  WHERE
    p.gender = 'M'
    AND p.anchor_age BETWEEN 71 AND 81
    AND LOWER(dc.long_title) LIKE '%acute respiratory distress syndrome%'
),

-- 2. ICU stays for that cohort, with 72h cutoff
icu_72h AS (
  SELECT
    icu.subject_id,
    icu.hadm_id,
    icu.stay_id,
    icu.intime,
    icu.outtime,
    TIMESTAMP_DIFF(
      LEAST(icu.outtime, TIMESTAMP_ADD(icu.intime, INTERVAL 72 HOUR)),
      icu.intime,
      SECOND
    ) AS window_secs
  FROM
    ards_cohort c
    JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_icu.icustays` icu
      USING(subject_id, hadm_id)
),

-- 3. Compute instability score per patient in first 72h
instability_events AS (
  SELECT
    i.subject_id,
    i.hadm_id,
    i.stay_id,
    COUNTIF(
      (di.label = 'Heart Rate'    AND ce.valuenum > 100)
      OR (di.label = 'Respiratory Rate' AND ce.valuenum > 20)
      OR (di.label = 'O2 saturation'     AND ce.valuenum < 90)
      OR (di.label = 'Arterial BP [Systolic]' AND ce.valuenum < 90)
    ) AS instability_score
  FROM
    icu_72h i
    JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_icu.chartevents` ce
      ON ce.subject_id = i.subject_id
     AND ce.stay_id    = i.stay_id
     AND ce.charttime BETWEEN i.intime
                         AND TIMESTAMP_ADD(i.intime, INTERVAL i.window_secs SECOND)
    JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_icu.d_items` di
      ON ce.itemid = di.itemid
  GROUP BY
    i.subject_id,
    i.hadm_id,
    i.stay_id
),

-- 4. 90th percentile threshold
pct90 AS (
  SELECT
    APPROX_QUANTILES(instability_score, 100)[OFFSET(90)] AS thr
  FROM
    instability_events
),

-- 5. High-instability patients
high_instab AS (
  SELECT
    ie.subject_id,
    ie.hadm_id,
    ie.stay_id,
    ie.instability_score
  FROM
    instability_events ie
    CROSS JOIN pct90
  WHERE
    ie.instability_score >= pct90.thr
),

-- 6a. Outcomes for high-instability group
high_outcomes AS (
  SELECT
    hi.subject_id,
    hi.hadm_id,
    ar.hospital_expire_flag,
    ic.los,
    -- lab abnormality rate in first 72h
    COUNTIF(l.flag = 'abnormal') / COUNT(*) AS lab_abn_rate
  FROM
    high_instab hi
    JOIN ards_cohort ar
      USING(subject_id, hadm_id)
    JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_icu.icustays` ic
      ON hi.subject_id = ic.subject_id
     AND hi.stay_id   = ic.stay_id
    LEFT JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.labevents` l
      ON hi.subject_id = l.subject_id
     AND hi.hadm_id    = l.hadm_id
     AND l.charttime BETWEEN ic.intime
                       AND LEAST(ic.outtime, TIMESTAMP_ADD(ic.intime, INTERVAL 72 HOUR))
  GROUP BY
    hi.subject_id, hi.hadm_id, ar.hospital_expire_flag, ic.los
),

-- 7. General comparator: male aged 71-81 inpatients (all)
gen_cohort AS (
  SELECT
    a.subject_id,
    a.hadm_id,
    a.admittime
  FROM
    `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.admissions` a
    JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.patients` p
      ON a.subject_id = p.subject_id
  WHERE
    p.gender = 'M'
    AND p.anchor_age BETWEEN 71 AND 81
),

gen_lab_rate AS (
  SELECT
    gc.subject_id,
    gc.hadm_id,
    COUNTIF(l.flag = 'abnormal') / COUNT(*) AS lab_abn_rate
  FROM
    gen_cohort gc
    LEFT JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.labevents` l
      ON gc.subject_id = l.subject_id
     AND gc.hadm_id   = l.hadm_id
  GROUP BY
    gc.subject_id, gc.hadm_id
)

-- Final aggregation and reporting
SELECT
  pct90.thr                                             AS instability_90th_pct,
  -- High-instability group results
  AVG(high_outcomes.hospital_expire_flag)               AS mortality_rate,
  AVG(high_outcomes.los)                                AS mean_icu_los_days,
  AVG(high_outcomes.lab_abn_rate)                       AS high_instab_lab_abn_rate,
  -- Comparator lab rate
  AVG(gen_lab_rate.lab_abn_rate)                        AS general_lab_abn_rate
FROM
  pct90
  LEFT JOIN high_outcomes ON TRUE
  LEFT JOIN gen_lab_rate ON TRUE;
